description: Fetch historical observation records from a NOAA CDO dataset for a given date range. Requires datasetId, startDate, and endDate; optionally filter stations, locations, and datatypes. The encoded query is limited to 4000 characters; reduce filters and make separate calls if exceeded. Sub-daily, daily, and radar datasets allow 1 year; GSOM/GSOY/NORMAL_MLY/NORMAL_ANN allow 10 years, through the end of the corresponding calendar month. NORMAL_* datasets are the superseded 1981–2010 normals, dated in the API proxy year 2010; for the current 1991–2020 normals use noaa_climate_get_normals. Request units=metric or units=standard: omitted units retain datatype-specific raw scales. Examples: GHCND TMAX/TMIN tenths °C, PRCP tenths mm, SNOW/SNWD whole mm; GSOM/GSOY temperature/precipitation °C/mm; NORMAL_* temperature normals tenths °F and precipitation normals hundredths inches; PRECIP_HLY/HPCP and PRECIP_15/QPCP hundredths inches. These examples are not universal conversion rules. Missing precipitation rows omit value and carry missing=true; GHCND flags expose quality-check failures without dropping values.

datasetId.description: Dataset ID to query (e.g., GHCND for daily data, GSOM for monthly, GSOY for annual, NORMAL_DLY/MLY/ANN/HLY for the superseded 1981–2010 normals, NEXRAD2/NEXRAD3 for weather radar); noaa_climate_get_normals serves the current 1991–2020 normals. Determines date range limit: GHCND/PRECIP_*/NORMAL_DLY/NORMAL_HLY/NEXRAD2/NEXRAD3 allow 1-year max per request; GSOM/GSOY/NORMAL_MLY/NORMAL_ANN allow 10-year max.

datatypeId.description: One or more data type IDs to include (e.g., ["TMAX", "TMIN", "PRCP"]). Without this, all data types for the dataset are returned. Use noaa_climate_list_data_types to discover valid IDs. Optional.

endDate.description: End date for observations (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be within 1 year of startDate for sub-daily/daily/radar datasets (GHCND, PRECIP_15, PRECIP_HLY, NORMAL_DLY, NORMAL_HLY, NEXRAD2, NEXRAD3) or within 10 years for monthly/annual datasets (GSOM, GSOY, NORMAL_MLY, NORMAL_ANN) — measured to the end of the calendar month that many years after startDate, so a full calendar year (2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31) always fits. For any NORMAL_* dataset use 2010-12-31.

includemetadata.description: Include pagination metadata in the response. Defaults to true.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–1000). Defaults to 25. Larger positive integers are clamped to 1000 with a notice unless NOAA_CLAMP_LIMITS=false.

locationId.description: One or more location IDs to filter by (e.g., ["FIPS:37", "ZIP:98101"]). Broader than stationId — returns data from all stations within the location. Optional.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return for pagination. Defaults to 0.

sortField.description: Sort results by this field. Optional.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction. Optional; defaults to asc.

startDate.description: Start date for observations (YYYY-MM-DD). For NORMAL_* datasets use 2010-01-01 — CDO dates its 1981–2010 normals in the proxy year 2010.

stationId.description: One or more station IDs to filter by (e.g., ["GHCND:USW00024233"]). Obtain from noaa_climate_find_stations. Multiple IDs return comparative readings across stations. Optional.

items.description: Station ID. Trims surrounding whitespace, uppercases IDs, and accepts bare 11-character GHCN aliases (USW00024233 → GHCND:USW00024233). Other namespaced IDs remain accepted.

units.description: Request metric or standard conversion. Omission preserves datatype-specific raw values: GHCND TMAX/TMIN tenths °C, PRCP tenths mm, SNOW/SNWD whole mm; GSOM/GSOY temperature/precipitation °C/mm; NORMAL_* temperature normals tenths °F and precipitation normals hundredths inches; HPCP/QPCP hundredths inches. Examples are not complete unit metadata. Under metric, CDO converts some NORMAL_* degree days, diurnal ranges, and standard deviations as if they were temperatures, which makes them wrong: -HTDD-NORMAL, -CLDD-NORMAL, -GRDD-TB4886, -GRDD-TB5086, and -DUTR-NORMAL on NORMAL_MLY and NORMAL_ANN; -STDDEV on NORMAL_MLY; -DUTR-NORMAL and -STDDEV on NORMAL_DLY. For those omit units and convert the raw values (whole °F-day degree days ×5/9, tenths-°F ranges and standard deviations ×1/18). Optional.

name: noaa_climate_fetch_data

effectiveQuery.description: Summary of the effective query: dataset, date range, units, and any station/location/datatype filters applied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `service_unavailable`: NOAA CDO API is unreachable or returning errors. `rate_limited`: NOAA CDO throttled the request — the configured token went over its rate limit. `date_range_exceeded`: endDate is past the end of the calendar month 1 year after startDate for sub-daily/daily/radar datasets (GHCND, PRECIP_*, NORMAL_DLY, NORMAL_HLY, NEXRAD2, NEXRAD3), or 10 years after it for monthly/annual datasets (GSOM, GSOY, NORMAL_MLY, NORMAL_ANN). `upstream_auth_failed`: NOAA CDO rejected the API token this server is configured with. `validation_error`: Bad dataset ID, date format, unknown station/location/datatype ID, or encoded observation query exceeding 4000 characters. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

exhausted.description: True when the requested offset is past the end of a non-empty result set — the page is empty but matches exist. Omitted otherwise.

resultset.description: Pagination cursor fields for this response.

limit.description: Page size used for this response.

offset.description: Zero-based starting index of this page, echoing the requested offset.

notice.description: Composed guidance for station ID normalization, page-limit adjustments, routing from the 1981–2010 NORMAL_* datasets to the 1991–2020 normals, raw units, NORMAL_* values CDO mis-converts under units=metric, NCEI special-value codes on NORMAL_* pages, missing precipitation, GHCND quality-check failures, and empty or exhausted pages. Omitted when no guidance applies.

results.description: Flat array of observation records sorted by date by default.

attributes.description: Untouched upstream attributes. GHCND positions are measurement, quality, source, observation time; other datasets have their own layouts documented at https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/cdo/documentation/.

flags.description: Decoded GHCND attributes only. Absent trailing positions remain omitted; raw attributes and numeric values are retained.

measurement.description: GHCND measurement flag; an explicit blank is preserved.

observationTime.description: GHCND local observation time, preserving leading zeros and explicit blanks.

quality.description: GHCND quality flag; a nonblank code means a failed quality check. Explicit blanks are preserved.

source.description: GHCND source flag, including unknown codes and explicit blanks.

missing.description: True for a documented PRECIP_HLY/HPCP or PRECIP_15/QPCP missing sentinel; value is omitted.

station.description: Station ID that recorded this observation.

value.description: Observed value, omitted for identified missing precipitation. With units omitted, scale depends on datatype: GHCND TMAX/TMIN tenths °C, PRCP tenths mm, SNOW/SNWD whole mm; GSOM/GSOY temperature/precipitation °C/mm; NORMAL_* temperature normals tenths °F, precipitation normals hundredths inches; HPCP/QPCP hundredths inches. Examples are not universal conversion rules.

totalCount.description: Total number of matching observation records before the page limit.

title: Fetch NOAA Climate Observation Data
